stack: Next.js 16.3.8 (App Router, proxy.ts instead of middleware, Cache Components), React 19.2, Tailwind v4, shadcn on Radix, lucide-react, cmdk; Supabase (auth + Postgres); deployed on Cloudflare via @opennextjs/cloudflare and wrangler; built-in in-memory demo mode when Supabase env is empty

brand_gaps: Credit line: no 'Angka · by AntaraX' anywhere in the app chrome; sign-in footer says 'REKA Inisiatif Sdn Bhd' and the AXLE footer 'Run by REKA Inisiatif Sdn Bhd' (13 and the Angka sheet want the credit plus legal line). The Lapis footer ('Lapis is part of Angka, and Angka is part of AntaraX, the AI studio from REKA') is the nearest to the target.

AXLE look (13 §6): today it is the app's light paper and plum shell with a light/dark/system toggle and the Angka mascot, named 'AXLE / The console for Angka', on axle.angka.antarax.ai. Target: dark-only #071233 / #0C1B47, REKA orange #FB9800 accent, AntaraX A in the corner, 'AXLE · Angka', axle.antarax.ai, one staff sign-in across products.
Focus ring is plum #9B6F9B (app and AXLE); the shared rule is AntaraX blue #0459F7 in every product (09, 13 §10).
Type: Caveat handwriting in the Home hero and Lapis card, Geist Mono for mono; target Poppins plus JetBrains Mono, drop Caveat. Headline figures are Poppins, not mono.
Several taglines live in the chrome at once: 'Simpler together.' (wordmark), 'Less busywork. More forward.' (hero), 'Business clarity for what's next' (Home nav about line).
Dark mode ground is #1D191C (warm); the kit asks to move it towards #071233. Text #2D2A26 should move to the shared core navy over time.

AntaraX layer touchpoints missing in the shell: no AntaraX app tiles or product switcher beyond Angka|Lapis, no intan eyebrow, no congkak motif in empty states (the mascot is used in AXLE empty states), AI sparkle only on Ask, not beside AI matches in the nav or Inbox chrome.
Help (13 §8): Help is in the profile menu and /help exists, but there is no /guide in REKA user-guide format and no help link on the sign-in screen; AXLE has no Help item.
AXLE shows money as 'USD 0.000'; the standard is US$.
Error page copy 'This page tripped over itself' (seen while capturing) breaks the error pattern in 03/13.
Uppercase micro labels: 'PILOT' chip and uppercase group labels ('YOUR BUSINESS', 'WATCH'); check against the kit's sentence-case and intan eyebrow rule.
AXLE nav is 28 items in one sidebar (needs inner scroll even at 900px tall) and a 28-chip sideways row on phones with no group labels.

DESIGN.md is stale against the code: it says a 248px sidebar (customer is 264px), Geist Sans (Poppins), groups Overview/Records/Insight/Workspace (code: unlabelled, Your business, How it's going), counts on Home, Inbox and Documents (code: Home, Inbox, To pay), 'no toggle is exposed yet' for dark mode (it is in the profile menu), a mode toggle in the header (now the Angka|Lapis toggle) and a ⌘K trigger in the sidebar (CommandPaletteTrigger exists but is unused).
notes: Everything captured from a local dev server (port 3106) in the repo's own demo mode (npm run dev:demo equivalent): no secrets, no remote backend, fictional data.
